units.title: FileStorageEngine with SHA-256 dedup + version tracking
units.ship_notes: Engine `src/engines/FileStorageEngine.ts` (15094 bytes, pre-existing) implements full deliverable: SHA-256 dedup via hashIndex Map, version tracking via versions Map of FileVersion[], polymorphic entity attachments with 12 entity_type + 10 attachment_type allowlists, soft-delete with hashIndex cleanup, content-addressed disk storage under uploads/<first-2-chars>/, MIME-from-extension detection covering 28 manufacturing-relevant types (.step .iges .stl .dxf .pdf .nc .gcode etc.), 100 MB default size cap (PRISM_MAX_FILE_SIZE knob), base64-string content accepted alongside Buffer. Singleton exported as `fileStorageEngine` and wired via partsRouter (file_upload, file_download, file_get_versions, file_attach, file_get_attachments, file_find_by_hash, file_delete + getFile/listFiles/getStats). 35 vitest cases shipped 2026-05-13 closing the previously-missing test coverage exit condition.
